reason: All six scope items are implemented and verified at 782 passing tests, up from 743 at admission. The unpopulated-reference case returns unavailable with an enumerated reason on all 210 pre-slice records rather than an empty ancestor set. That is recorded in VERIFY-20260817-0001 rather than smoothed over, because it is the strongest available evidence about what the two-party arrangement buys: the packaging executor twice believed the condition was satisfied, and twice it was not.
